whyLargeProject: 13 modules, 30+ cross-module functional requirements, RBAC, workflow engine, audit log, notifications, reporting, import/export, background jobs. Scope exceeds what single-agent Codex can handle without simplification or quality degradation.
failureModesToExpose: Quality drift (superficial tests, missing error handling)
whyMultiAgentMightHelp: Isolated builders can own modules end-to-end. Orchestrator prevents scope creep. Verifier gates catch contract drift. Lifecycle tracks completion. Anti-deception detects fallback.
whyV04Insufficient: v0.4 provides process integrity verification but no agent isolation, no task orchestration, no worker capsules, no anti-deception gates. v0.4 verifies artifacts exist; v0.5 governs how they are produced.
multiAgentSuccessDefinition: v0.5 produces measurably higher quality product (fewer defects, better architecture, more complete feature set) than Vanilla or v0.4, with acceptable overhead, no hidden fallback, and verifiable agent contributions.
multiAgentFailureDefinition: v0.5 product quality does not exceed v0.4 or Vanilla, OR multi-agent overhead outweighs benefit, OR hidden fallback detected, OR agents fail to isolate work.
inconclusiveDefinition: Runs not comparable (divergent implementations), OR evaluator lacks evidence for comparison, OR external factors dominate (environmental failure, API changes).
